serp_refs: Marketplace scan: feelings and emotions rugs are searched with feelings wheel, mental health, classroom calm corner, therapy office, SEL and kids emotion chart terms.
Marketplace scan: classroom notebook rugs use composition notebook, custom teacher name, classroom decor, welcome mat, round rug and back-to-school modifiers.
Marketplace scan: Spanish classroom rugs use Spanish ABC, bilingual alphabet, Bienvenidos, maestra name, preschool, kindergarten and Spanish learning mat wording.
keyword_evidence: Use education-specific long tails: kids feelings rug, feelings wheel classroom rug, classroom calm corner rug, composition notebook classroom rug, personalized teacher classroom rug, Spanish ABC classroom rug, bilingual alphabet rug and Spanish learning rug.
buyer_summary: B054 buyers are teachers, school counselors, therapists and parents creating classroom or playroom floor zones. They want readable learning prompts, custom teacher names, soft/non slip construction, group activity use, and decor that feels cheerful rather than clinical.
purchase_concerns: Avoid medical claims for feelings/mental-health rugs; describe them as classroom, therapy-office or SEL conversation aids. For Spanish rugs, keep wording as Spanish/bilingual classroom decor, not a full curriculum. Separate round notebook rugs from rectangular Spanish learning mats.
